An advanced active noise cancelling system cuts outside noise by up to 42 dB. Adaptive technology reads the sound around you and selects the level that suits your ears on its own, and you can still set it by hand across 5 levels and 3 modes.
Let the world in or stay with your audio, the choice is yours. Switch to transparency mode to hear what is around you without taking the earbuds out.
10mm drivers amplified by soundcore's own BassUp technology unleash deep, punchy bass for a full and robust sound.

With ANC off you get 10 hours from a single charge and 45 hours in total with the charging case. With ANC on that becomes 7 hours per charge and 30 hours in total. A 10-minute charge over USB-C adds 2 more hours.
Open the back panel of the case, rest your phone on the stand and watch hands-free. Catching up on your favorite shows while traveling has never been easier.

The earbuds carry an IP54 rating against splashes and are fully dustproof. Bluetooth 5.4 pairs in one step, multipoint lets you switch between your laptop and your phone, and 4 microphones with an AI algorithm keep your calls clear.
